visualCharacteristics.structure: left-aligned wrapping grid of logos (empty slots keep logos at the left)
visualCharacteristics.columns: 6 slots of 16% from 1280px, 4 from 768px, 2 on mobile; gap 24px 8px

contentPattern: Logo row for certifications, benchmarking and partner groups. One row with one logo per cell (or one logo per row); logos may be linked. The group H2 ('Certifications', 'Benchmarking', 'Partners') and the separating horizontal rule are default content around each block.
